sloka: तथाऽन्ये तापसाः सिद्धा रामम् वैश्वानर उपमाः ।न्याय वृत्ता यथा न्यायम् तर्पयामासुर् ईश्वरम् ॥३-१-२३॥
transliteration: tathā'nye tāpasāḥ siddhā rāmam vaiśvānara upamāḥ ।nyāya vṛttā yathā nyāyam tarpayāmāsur īśvaram ॥3-1-23॥

translations.english: Likewise other accomplished ascetics, like the fire itself and righteous in conduct, gratified Rama the lord according to rule.
